description: Second npm data part of Slaunt Audit's bundled TinyLlama 1.1B GGUF model
readme:
# Slaunt Audit bundled model data (part 2)

This package is an immutable data part of the Apache-2.0 TinyLlama 1.1B Chat
IQ2_XXS model embedded in `slaunt`. `slaunt` verifies the part size and the
assembled model SHA-256 before loading it locally.

Do not install this data part directly. It is pulled automatically by the
`slaunt` package.
